title: One 18-Inch Pizza Has More Pizza Than Two 12-Inch Pizzas
caption: Pizza is sold by width, but you eat the area (π × r²). One 18-inch pizza ≈ 254.5 sq in; two 12-inch pizzas ≈ 226.2 sq in. The difference (≈28.3 sq in) is exactly one 6-inch pizza. Double the width = 4x the pizza, so compare price per square inch. Crust and toppings vary. Education only, not financial advice. Voice: AI (Kokoro TTS). #pizza #mathtok #moneytok #lifehack
